priority.override_reason: Rank 1 controlflow-recursive is closed by the rejected direct-leaf tail and same-function frame-stack mechanisms. The fresh rank-2 and rank-3 profiles independently retain NamedPropertyCache get/update work on ordinary own data properties whose values are not eligible for Exact caching. Rank-4 hash-map exposes the same cost but is kept as a regression control because its sampled fraction is lower. This is not the previously rejected inherited-prototype cache: it only records a proven own data slot and never changes prototype lookup.

mechanism.summary: When an ordinary own named-data read returns a value that Exact cannot retain without extending heap reachability, cache the receiver's weak identity, layout revision, and existing own-data slot, then read the current value from that slot on a hit.
mechanism.generality: Eligibility comes only from the existing ordinary own-data read and live slot/layout checks. It applies to Function, String, BigInt, Array, Map, Set, Proxy, and other non-Exact value variants at every static named-property site, without inspecting source paths, benchmark names, checksums, or iteration counts. Inherited, accessor, exotic, Proxy-receiver, typed-array, module-namespace, and primitive-receiver reads retain their existing paths.
semantic_risks: the cached slot must be invalidated by every structural change through the receiver layout revision
a value replacement with unchanged layout must return the replacement rather than the stale cached value
the cache must retain only the receiver weak reference and no heap value, so it cannot extend object or function lifetime
accessor and inherited-property reads must still clear the cache and use the current slow path
